subject: Order Form: pricing ramp, invoicing cadence & VAT allocation
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Order form questions — pricing ramp & VAT treatment

Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we prepare to circulate the order form internally at Novamed, procurement has a couple of items they need clarified before we re-share with legal: 

1) Pricing ramp: The three-tier ramp looks fine but we need the explicit token thresholds for each month in the first 12 months (not just quarterly buckets). Can you provide a per-month illustration?

2) Minimum commits: Is it possible to convert the fixed minimum to a staircase that triggers at month 4 and month 8 (rather than all at signing)? Our finance team prefers phased recognition.

3) Net terms & invoicing cadence: We typically run Net 60 for pilot customers. Your order form currently shows Net 30. Can Redwood accept Net 60 for Novamed while we start with a partial prepay? If not, what are the alternatives (PO routing, escrow for advance amounts)?

4) VAT / reverse charge: Novamed will be using EU reverse charge for software services. We need a short clause confirming Redwood will not gross up EU VAT for EU-registered customers and will accept a VAT-exempt invoice when we provide the VAT ID.

I've attached the procurement checklist and a sample invoice cadence that our accounting team prefers.

Can you confirm changes or point us to how this will be captured in the order form redlines?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement — Novamed
attachments: procurement_checklist.pdf; preferred_invoice_cadence.xlsx

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — pricing ramp & VAT treatment

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below; we'll coordinate the redline capture with Legal.

1) Pricing ramp per month: attaching an XLS with a per-month illustration for a 12-month pilot based on the tiered bands we discussed. See attachment: Invoice_Schedule_Table.xlsx.

2) Minimum commits: We can support a 3-step staircase (signing / month 4 / month 8) but need to preserve the economic minimum in aggregate. Legal will need to translate into milestones in the order form so invoicing triggers align.

3) Net terms: Standard Redwood Net 30 is our default. For enterprise procurement UAT/pilot cases we have accepted Net 45 or Net 60 with an upfront activation fee (usually 25% of year-1 commit) plus PO on file. Ben, can you confirm whether sales is prepared to accept a 25% prepay + Net 60 proposal for Novamed?

4) VAT: We will accept reverse charge treatment for EU-registered buyers who provide a valid VAT ID. Kimberly, please confirm the language we should add to the tax section and whether we need a separate EU VAT cover sheet.

I'll produce a redline of the order form (tracked changes) and circulate by Tuesday.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
attachments: Invoice_Schedule_Table.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 08:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — pricing ramp & VAT treatment

Hi all — looping in Laura (finance ops) to validate invoicing flow and PO / prepay handling.

Legal/tax notes for redline: 
- VAT: We'll add a short "EU reverse charge" clause: "Where Buyer provides a valid EU VAT registration number, Seller shall issue an invoice excluding VAT and Buyer shall account for VAT under the reverse charge mechanism, provided Buyer indemnifies Seller for any VAT liability arising due to incorrect information."
- Gross-up: Redwood will not gross up net amounts for EU reverse charge; any VAT liability caused by Buyer error is Buyer responsibility.
- Evidence: Buyer must provide VAT ID and a signed Statement of Entitlement prior to VAT-exempt invoicing.

Invoicing cadence options: 1) 25% activation prepay + monthly invoices (Net 60) for the remainder; 2) 50% prepay + quarterly invoices (Net 60); 3) No prepay but Net 30 standard (requires finance escalation). If Novamed prefers Net 60 with 25% prepay we can route through finance and set PO as invoice routing.

Laura — can you confirm whether our AR team will accept Net 60 with PO on file and a 25% activation prepay? If yes we'll reflect the milestone schedule in the order form and request DocuSign tiers.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order form questions — pricing ramp & VAT treatment

Elena / team —

Finance is OK to accept Net 60 for this deal on the following conditions:
- 25% activation prepay collected at signing (we will issue an activation invoice immediately upon countersignature).
- Remaining 75% invoiced monthly with Net 60 terms; invoices will reference the PO number (PO on file required).
- Staircase minimum commits: we will accept milestone-based invoicing if the order form includes explicit month-4 and month-8 acceptance milestones that trigger billing; acceptance = services provisioned + usage attestation.
- VAT: upon receipt of valid EU VAT ID and Statement of Entitlement we will issue VAT-exempt invoices. Any retrospective VAT assessed by authorities due to missing/incorrect VAT ID will be billed to Buyer.

Action items I will take:
1) Upload a redline of the order form that captures the staircase milestones, the activation invoice line, and the invoice references by PO. (attached: Novamed_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf)
2) Push a DocuSign envelope with two signature lines: activation invoice acceptance + standard order form.

Ben — please confirm commercial OK on the 25% activation fee so Markus can send the redline to Elena for review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: Novamed_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf; internal_ar_notes.txt
